sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual), Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You utilize your Swift release, manifesting illusory duplicates of yourself maintained by your speed alone as three clones of yourself appear in your space.

For the Jutsu’s duration, the clones move with you and mimic your actions, shifting positions so it’s impossible to track which image is real. You can use your bonus action to dismiss the clones.

Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the jutsu's duration, roll a d8 for each of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d8’s are 4 or higher, one of the duplicates are hit instead of you, and the duplicate is dismissed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. This jutsu ends when all duplicates are destroyed.

If the creature that targets you has True Sight, Tremor Sense, or Chakra Sight instead on a roll of 6 or higher, the duplicate is hit instead of you.

Interdiction Seal. When you attack a creature marked with this seal, your duplicates join in. You can dispel one clone you currently have active to grant yourself a d4 bonus to the attack result. Alternatively, creatures marked with this seal that deals damage to you as a result of an attack they make, reduce the number needed to roll on the d8 to make the attack hit the duplicate by 2.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the number of duplicates you have by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of duplicates you have by +2.
